items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: Chris Kelly, Black Benny, Shiller Stein, Piku. He had more than anyone else.

ctx.x: I never heard about Chris Kelly's funeral much. They had three.

Man, you're the same as carnival around here when they buried Chris Kelly. I was saying, Chris Kelly, Black Benny, Shiller Stein, Piku. He had more than anyone else. There was four of the biggest funerals you can remember. Yeah. With the musicians. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. That's a G. It's around the same as people lined up side to side walk, the same as a carnival.
Where did Chris Kelly live about in those days? What part of town?
